message.content:
Elegant silk-blend sheath dress with a subtle draped neckline, knee-length hem, color #d9b48f to harmonize with her skin tone, fabric flowing softly to flatter her natural curves.  
Opaque wool blend tailored trousers with a high waist and slim ankle-cut, charcoal gray #2a2a2a to ground the festive look while maintaining warmth for frosty weather, structured weave offering sleek silhouette.  

This outfit works because it balances festive elegance with practical warmth for a New Year's restaurant celebration in cold weather. The warm-toned dress complements her skin and hair hues perfectly, creating a cohesive and polished appearance suitable for a formal occasion. Adding a simple gold clutch and heels elevates the look without overwhelming the sophisticated simplicity of the trousers.
